agentGuide: MnemoBudget keeps what the person spends (paid) and plans to spend (planned), in pockets (Home, Restaurant, Shop, Children…) split into categories (Dog, Rent, Groceries…).

A sentence with an amount PAID (« j'ai payé 80 € de croquettes pour le chien ») is addExpense. A future one (« je prévois », « le loyer c'est 1200 € tous les 5 ») is planExpense, with repeat when it comes back. « C'est payé / I paid the rent » for something planned is markPaid. « Non, c'était 18 € » is correctExpense on the last line.

Pass pocket and category in the person's own words, never invented: the app matches them and says what exists. When only a category is said (« le chien »), leave pocket out: the app finds the pocket that holds it.
🚨 day and when: COPY the person's words (« hier », « lundi », « en décembre », « le 5 »), never compute a date. Leave them out when not said.
currency: the word said (« euros », « dirhams », « $ »); leave it out when none is said.
Questions about money (« combien j'ai dépensé », « il me reste combien ») are summary: the app answers with its own sums, say nothing of your own.
Never delete: nothing here removes a line.

agentActions.summary: Write down money that was PAID: amount, pocket, category, what it was, the day. It waits in « À vérifier » until the person looks at it.
agentActions.details: Answers the line written and what is left on that category's monthly cap when one is set. Refused NO_POCKET (with the pockets) when neither the pocket nor a known category is said; a category the pocket does not have is created and said.

currency.description: The currency word said (euros, dirhams, $). Leave out when none is said.

pocket.description: The pocket as the person says it (maison, le restaurant, le magasin). Leave out when not said.

category.description: The category as the person says it (chien, courses, loyer).

label.description: What was bought, in the person's words (croquettes).

day.description: The day in the person's own words (hier, lundi, le 5). Never a computed date. Leave out for today.

agentActions.summary: Write down money the person PLANS to spend: once (« en décembre ») or coming back (repeat: the rent every 5th).
agentActions.details: A plan is never counted as spent. It becomes spent with markPaid.

currency.description: The currency word said. Leave out when none is said.

pocket.description: The pocket as the person says it. Leave out when not said.

category.description: The category as the person says it.

label.description: What it is for, in the person's words.

when.description: When, in the person's own words (en décembre, le 5, lundi). Never a computed date.

repeat.description: When it comes back: weekly, monthly or yearly. Leave out for once.

agentActions.summary: Mark a planned line as paid (« j'ai payé le loyer »). Name it by its words (loyer, femme de ménage) or its category.
agentActions.details: Refused AMBIGUOUS with the candidates when several plans match; NO_PLAN when none is due.

what.description: The plan as the person names it (le loyer, la femme de ménage).

amount.description: The amount actually paid, when the person says a different one.

day.description: The day paid, in the person's words. Leave out for today.

agentActions.summary: Correct a line already written (« non, c'était 18 € », « mets-le dans Restaurant »). Without what, the last line written is corrected.

what.description: The line as the person names it (les croquettes). Leave out for the last line written.

day.description: The right day, in the person's words.

agentActions.summary: Set the monthly cap of a category (« 120 € par mois pour le chien »).

category.description: The category as the person says it.

pocket.description: The pocket, when the person says it.

agentActions.summary: What was spent, what is planned and what is left, for a month, a pocket or a category; shows it on screen.
agentActions.details: Answers with the app's own sums (say). A currency the person gave no rate for is counted apart, never converted.

month.description: The month in the person's words (ce mois, octobre, le mois dernier). Leave out for this month.
